releaseNotes:
Feature: Pull & Deploy when behind remote, with optional Commit & Push first
Feature: Deploy tab moved first in the main header
Feature: Deploy CPU refresh interval (10/30/60/Off) with colored chips and manual sync
Feature: Direct Upload auto disk-sync chip and smarter select/deselect merge
Feature: Backup Scheduler 6-step wizard (Basics, Local DB, Strategy, VPN, Ready, Confirm)
Feature: Per-schedule OpenVPN connect before backup / disconnect only if this run opened it
Feature: Backup plan Import/Export JSON with linked connections
Fix: Settings → Server no longer hangs on open when syncing theme/terminal
Fix: Settings Server text readable again under Dark theme
